name: shinchantw_cbt_stage_schema_20260729_182004_650896
sql:
SELECT '#18' AS source, CAST(a_rst[1].key AS VARCHAR) AS field_key,
       CAST(a_rst[1].id AS VARCHAR) AS field_id, CAST(a_rst[1].name AS VARCHAR) AS field_name,
       COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM ta.v_event_18
WHERE "$part_date"='2026-07-29' AND "#event_name"='stage_fight'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
UNION ALL
SELECT '#13', CAST(a_rst[1].key AS VARCHAR), CAST(a_rst[1].id AS VARCHAR), CAST(a_rst[1].name AS VARCHAR), COUNT(*)
FROM ta.v_event_13
WHERE "$part_date"='2026-05-08' AND "#event_name"='stage_fight'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY 1,5 DESC
LIMIT 100;
